### NousResearch/hermes-agent

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

The self-improving AI agent built by Nous Research. It's the only agent with a built-in learning loop — it creates skills from experience, improves them during use, nudges itself to persist knowledge, searches its own past conversations, and builds a deepening model of who you are across sessions. R

</details>

### Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

Describe what you want done. AutoGPT builds the agent, runs it, and reports back.

</details>

### volcengine/OpenViking

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents — one filesystem for everything an agent knows: knowledge, memory, and skills.

</details>

### ComposioHQ/composio

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

Composio gives your AI agents 1000+ pre-authenticated toolkits, per-user sessions, authentication, triggers, and a sandbox, so you can ship agents that turn intent into action.

</details>

### trycua/cua

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

- Cua Spaces: Install the app and run your first Space. - Cua Driver: Operate Calculator and verify its result. - Lume: Create a Tahoe VM and connect over SSH. - Cua SDK and CLI: Install cua and create a local sandbox. - CUA-S1: Explore small, specialized models for computer-use decisions. - Cua Ben

</details>

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

</details>

### tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

Claude Code plugin that replaces the compaction summary with Jev decisions: every tool call and result is scored in one fast request, stale ones are dropped or truncated, everything kept stays verbatim. Also usable as an npm library.

</details>

### jev-chat/jev-chat-jarvis

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

Read them first, then reply. Before you answer, Jev works out what the other person really means, how risky the moment is and how to respond, then drafts replies you can fill in with one tap. Whether to send is always up to you.

</details>

### vercel-labs/fx

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

fx is a coding agent CLI written in Zig: a small native binary that is open source (Apache-2.0), model-agnostic, and embeddable as a harness in larger systems. Its interface stays closer to a Unix shell than an IDE in the terminal.

</details>

<details><summary>README 발췌</summary>

agent-desktop gives any agent reliable computer use on the desktop. Built with Rust, it sees any app's real UI structure through OS accessibility trees and operates it — refs stay stable and actions stay safe to retry, instead of guessing from pixels.

</details>
